said: I'm going to create a new deal in the CRM.

And you can view all the deals in the deals page.
And in the dashboard you can see all the pipeline value.
script: Click New deal to start creating a deal in the CRM.
Choose the contact for the deal from the list.
Click Next to proceed to the deal details.
Enter the deal amount in the Amount (USD) field.
Choose a stage from the Stage dropdown.
Set a date in the Expected close date field.
Click Next to review the deal details.
Click Create deal to finalize your new deal.
Click Dashboard to return and view your updated pipeline value.
